cands.bio: Michael Andrew Whitt is a Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 6, in office since November 2018. A longtime banker, he was a vice president at First American Bank (1996–2008) and has been senior vice president and Madison County Executive at First National Bank since 2008.
cands.gaps: We could not find where or when Whitt was born. We found no stated positions from him on data centers, property taxes, development, immigration, guns, abortion, schools or policing. The bill-sponsorship list on his Ballotpedia page was empty in the copy we read, so we could not confirm any bills he sponsored. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. Ballotpedia found no endorsements for him in 2026. We found no news reporting of controversies, and no records of foreign ties.
